answer: Sinkholes betray fraud before any audit does. In karst country, water quietly dissolves hidden tunnels, and the builder who papered over them pays when the ground drops. Bind each agent to a vault whose stake erodes exactly this way: peers route work to it and satisfaction slowly hardens the deposit, while a night of fabricated attestations dissolves the base underneath, collapsing the balance in one visible fall. An on-chain beacon publishes the erosion rate live, so nobody discovers the sinkhole after signing. Attacking the network then means pre-financing your own quiet demolition.
